title: Thailand Floods: Building Damage Assessment in Hat Yai

resources.description:
The images cover Hat Yai, Thailand.

Analysis was done on Planet SkySat imagery captured 11/30/2025.

Total buildings from Overture Maps: 70,516 
Intersected by flood predictions: 1,671 
Water within 20 meters: 3,219

Separately we labeled a random selection of 139 building footprints with area greater than 50 sq meters as flooded vs. not-flooded based on visible flood waters around the building and estimate that a total of 2005 buildings are affected (N=46439 buildings that are larger than 50 sq m) with a 95% CI of [432, 3577]. 

Overall, low damage in the city, but heavy flooding in the fields and along the river north of the city.
